1  BAIL APPL. NO. 3740 OF 2024  2  C.S.DIAS,J  --------------------------------------------
 Bail Application No.3740 of 2024  ---------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 12th day of July, 2024  ORDER

The application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure by the sole accused in Crime No.1341/2023 of the Sulthanbatheri Police Station, Wayanad, which is registered against him for committing the predicate offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(f), 376(2)(l),
376(2)(n), 376 AB and 377 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4(1), 4(2), 3(a), 6, 5(l), 5(m) and 5(n) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard; Sri.G.Hariharan, the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner and Sri.C.S.Hrithwik, the learned Public Prosecutor.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been acquitted by the Fast Track Special Court, Sulthanbatheri as per its judgment dated BAIL APPL. NO. 3740 OF 2024 11.07.2024 in S.C.No.86/2024.
Therefore, the bail application has become infructuous.
In the light of the above submission, the bail application is dismissed as infructuous.

Sd/-
